title: feat: add structured error diagnostics
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## What

- Adds one structured `diagnostic_metadata` field to Tinybird error events and the recent-errors endpoint.
- Captures Cloudflare colo, OpenRouter generation ID, and allowlisted Portkey trace, provider, retry, and route metadata.
- Labels `x-portkey-provider` as the gateway provider rather than claiming it is OpenRouter's selected downstream provider.
- Rejects all other response headers, including credentials and cookies.

## Why

Current error events preserve status and body but discard correlation and routing headers, making concentrated model failures difficult to reproduce and attribute.

## Checks

- `npx vitest run test/error-observability.test.ts`
- `npm run typecheck` in `gen.pollinations.ai`
- `npm run typecheck` in `enter.pollinations.ai`
- Biome check

No Tinybird or Cloudflare deployment was performed.

gist.headline: Errors grow little labels
gist.blurb: When a model hiccups, the hive now keeps the useful breadcrumbs. Correlation data gets a tidy little basket; cookies and credentials remain firmly outside it.
gist.summary: Error events and the recent-errors endpoint now include allowlisted diagnostic_metadata for Cloudflare colo, OpenRouter generation IDs, and Portkey trace, provider, retry, and route details.
gist.impact: Maintainers can more quickly correlate and reproduce concentrated model failures using routing metadata, while unapproved headers such as credentials and cookies are excluded.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy observability garden: Polli acts as a careful bug detective, sorting labeled diagnostic breadcrumbs into a transparent jar beside a retro error-monitor terminal. Small code-plants represent Cloudflare colo, OpenRouter generation IDs, and Portkey routing traces, while a locked cookie jar sits outside the collection basket to show sensitive headers are deliberately rejected.
